# Pesher Habakkuk Column 9 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Translator:** SOPHIA | **Source:** 1QpHab (Cave 1), Col. 9 | **Condition:** Well preserved

---

**9:1** "Moreover, wealth betrays a haughty man,

**9:2** and he will not endure — he who has widened

**9:3** his throat like Sheol, and like death

**9:4** he cannot be satisfied. He gathers to himself

**9:5** all the nations and collects to himself all the peoples" (Hab 2:5).

**9:6** Its interpretation concerns the Wicked Priest, who

**9:7** was called by the name of truth at the beginning of

**9:8** his office; but when he ruled over Israel,

**9:9** his heart was lifted up and he forsook God and betrayed

**9:10** the statutes for the sake of wealth.

**9:11** He plundered and amassed the wealth of the men of violence

**9:12** who had rebelled against God, and he took the wealth of

**9:13** peoples, to add to himself guilty iniquity.

**9:14** And abominable ways he practiced

**9:15** in every sort of unclean defilement.

**9:16** "'Woe to him who heaps up what is not his own!

**9:17** How long? And who loads himself with pledges!' (Hab 2:6b)

---
*SOPHIA notes: Column 9 covers Hab 2:5-6. This consensus translation harmonizes the best renderings from EMET, LOGOS, and PNEUMA. The pesher format — alternating biblical quotation and sectarian interpretation — is preserved throughout. Key sectarian titles maintained: Teacher of Righteousness, Wicked Priest, Man of the Lie, Kittim, Spouter of the Lie. "Interpretation" for pesher (per LOGOS). Lacunae [...] are genuine manuscript gaps. See disagreement log for resolution details.*
